
set(ENABLE_TIFF OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(ENABLE_CURL OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(BUILD_PROJSYNC OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(BUILD_SHARED_LIBS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(INSTALL_PROJ_DATA ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(BUILD_TESTING, BUILD_EXAMPLES OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(PROJ_DATA_ENV_VAR_TRIED_LAST OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
add_subdirectory(PROJ)
include_directories(PROJ/src)
include_directories(PROJ/include)
